title: What's the Best-selling Beer in the World? Not Budweiser
content:
When it comes to the best-selling beer in the world, most people think of Budweiser, Heineken, or maybe Corona.
But global beer rankings often look very different from what’s on tap at your local bar. The world’s top-selling beer brands reflect local preferences, massive populations, and powerhouse brewers with global reach.

Let’s check out the beer brands that currently hold the top spots worldwide.
